description: Store stores items by {priority, vesting_time, id} but stores leases solely by item_id. Reproduced: enqueue the same custom id at vesting times 1000 and 2000 -> two stored items and pending_count 2. They can share/overwrite one lease record and defeat completion/fencing. Re-enqueueing the identical item key also increments pending despite overwriting one row. QuiCK's optional supplied item ID can support idempotent enqueue; this API currently does not ensure it. Define the intended uniqueness scope, enforce uniqueness or reject duplicates, and test repeat enqueue before lease, while leased, and after completion.
title: Define and enforce custom job ID uniqueness
